rule: Only profiles present at the pinned commit are rendered. Missing stocks fail closed; no nearby stock is substituted.

portra160.name: Kodak Portra 160
portra160.notes: Negative printed on Portra Endura, matching the Zf/X100V project.

ektar100.name: Kodak Ektar 100
ektar100.notes: Print pairing follows the existing film_catalog.json; review before release.

gold200.name: Kodak Gold 200
gold200.notes: Print pairing chosen to match the other still negatives; review before release.

kodachrome64.name: Kodak Kodachrome 64
kodachrome64.notes: Positive (slide) film rendered as a direct film scan. The print profile is required by the API but unused; output was verified identical with kodak_portra_endura and kodak_2383.

vision3_250d.name: Kodak VISION3 250D
vision3_250d.notes: Cine negative printed on Kodak 2383, as in film_catalog.json.

vision3_500t.name: Kodak VISION3 500T
vision3_500t.notes: Tungsten-balanced cine negative printed on Kodak 2383. Daylight scenes will render warm-to-blue as film would; this is not an error.

doublex5222.name: Kodak Double-X 5222
doublex5222.notes: No profile at the pinned commit. Upstream branch 'dev' contains kodak_doublex.json and kodak_2302.json (B&W print); using them requires the maintainer to approve moving the pin.

trix400.name: Kodak Tri-X 400
trix400.notes: No profile at the pinned commit. Upstream branch 'dev' contains kodak_trix.json; using it requires approving a pin change. The pinned revision has no black-and-white pipeline.

hp5plus400.name: Ilford HP5 Plus 400
hp5plus400.notes: No Ilford profile exists upstream on the pinned commit or on the dev branch (checked 2026-11-16). Needs measured sensitometric data and a new profile.

superia400.name: Fujifilm Superia 400
superia400.notes: Not present upstream. fujifilm_xtra_400 is Superia X-TRA 400, a different emulsion, and must not be renamed or substituted without the maintainer's explicit decision.
